systems.name: Washington Public Employees' Retirement System

statute.quote: A state employees' retirement system is hereby created for the employees of the state of Washington and its political subdivisions.

source.quote: The administration and management of the retirement system, the responsibility for making effective the provisions of this chapter, and the authority to make all rules and regulations necessary therefor are hereby vested in the department.

website_source.quote: PERS Plan 2 retirement benefits for Washington public employees.

covers_local_source.quote: A state employees' retirement system is hereby created for the employees of the state of Washington and its political subdivisions.

systems.notes: Census lists PERS Plan 1 and Plans 2/3 separately; one system. RCW 41.40.020 names it the Washington Public Employees' Retirement System.

systems.name: Washington State Teachers' Retirement System

statute.quote: The name of the retirement system provided for in this chapter shall be the "Washington State Teachers' Retirement System" and by this name all of its business shall be transacted

source.quote: there is transferred to the department of retirement systems, except as otherwise provided in this chapter, all powers, duties, and functions of: (a) The Washington public employees' retirement system; (b) The Washington state teachers' retirement system;

website_source.quote: TRS Plan 2 retirement benefits for Washington public teachers.

covers_local_source.quote: "Employer" means the state of Washington, the school district, or any agency of the state of Washington by which the member is paid.

systems.notes: Census lists TRS Plan 1 and Plans 2/3 separately; one system.

statute.quote: A retirement system is hereby created for the employees of school districts or educational service districts.

source.quote: The administration and management of the retirement system, the responsibility for making effective the provisions of this chapter, and the authority to make all rules necessary therefor are hereby vested in the department.

website_source.quote: SERS Plan 2 retirement benefits for Washington school employees.

covers_local_source.quote: A retirement system is hereby created for the employees of school districts or educational service districts.

systems.name: Washington Law Enforcement Officers' and Firefighters' Retirement System

statute.quote: The Washington law enforcement officers' and firefighters' retirement system is hereby created for firefighters and law enforcement officers.

source.quote: there is transferred to the department of retirement systems, except as otherwise provided in this chapter, all powers, duties, and functions of: (a) The Washington public employees' retirement system; (b) The Washington state teachers' retirement system; (c) The Washington law enforcement officers' and firefighters' retirement system;

website_source.quote: LEOFF Plan 2 retirement benefits for Washington firefighters and law enforcement officers.

covers_local_source.quote: "Employer" for plan 1 members, means the legislative authority of any city, town, county, district, or regional fire protection service authority or the elected officials of any municipal corporation that employs any law enforcement officer and/or firefighter,

systems.notes: Census lists LEOFF Plan 1 (closed) and Plan 2 separately; one system. Plan 2 also has its own policy board (LEOFF Plan 2 Retirement Board).

systems.name: Washington State Patrol Retirement System

statute.quote: A Washington state patrol retirement fund is hereby established for members of the Washington state patrol which shall include funds created and placed under the management of a retirement board for the payment of retirement allowances and other benefits under the provisions hereof.

source.quote: there is transferred to the department of retirement systems, except as otherwise provided in this chapter, all powers, duties, and functions of: (a) The Washington public employees' retirement system; (b) The Washington state teachers' retirement system; (c) The Washington law enforcement officers' and firefighters' retirement system; (d) The Washington state patrol retirement system;

website_source.quote: WSPRS Plan 2 retirement benefits for Washington State Patrol members.

systems.notes: Census unit covers WSPRS Plans 1 and 2.

systems.name: Washington Public Safety Employees' Retirement System

statute.quote: A retirement system is hereby created for public safety employees of the Washington state department of corrections, the Washington state parks and recreation commission, the Washington state gambling commission, the Washington state patrol

source.quote: The administration and management of the retirement system, the responsibility for making effective the provisions of this chapter, and the authority to make all rules necessary therefor are hereby vested in the department.

website_source.quote: PSERS Plan 2 retirement benefits for Washington public safety employees.

covers_local_source.quote: the Washington *state liquor control board, county corrections departments, and city corrections departments not covered under chapter 41.28 RCW.

systems.name: Volunteer Firefighters' and Reserve Officers' Relief and Pension Fund

statute.quote: The volunteer firefighters' relief and pension principal fund is created in the state treasury as a trust fund for the benefit of the volunteer firefighter and emergency worker participants covered by this chapter

body.name: state board for volunteer firefighters and reserve officers

source.quote: The state board shall: (1) Generally supervise and control the administration of this chapter;

website_source.quote: It supplies all forms, reviews all claims, certifies all retirements and authorizes all payments from the Volunteer Firefighters´ and Reserve Officers´ Relief and Pension Fund.

covers_local_source.quote: Every municipal corporation maintaining and operating a regularly organized fire department shall make provision by appropriate legislation for the enrollment of every firefighter under the relief provisions of this chapter

systems.notes: Volunteer firefighters, emergency workers and reserve officers of local fire departments and districts.
